rows.title: Town Gate
rows.blurb: The Bramblewick gate frames the road. A watchtower, a kettle on the fire, dice on a stump.

rows.title: Town Square
rows.blurb: Bramblewick green: bunting, an old oak, a stone well. Ducks fuss.

rows.title: Tavern Common Room
rows.blurb: Low beams, a roaring hearth, long tables. The bar sells ale and stew; dice clatter in a corner booth.

rows.title: Tavern Guest Rooms
rows.blurb: A narrow hall of numbered doors. Muffled voices and a floorboard creak somewhere ahead.

rows.title: Tavern Cellar
rows.blurb: Stone steps, ale casks, damp lime. Something scrabbles behind the racks.

rows.title: Odds and Ends
rows.blurb: Narrow aisles between teetering piles — rope, pots, oddments stacked to the rafters.

rows.title: Red Anvil
rows.blurb: Heat hits you at the door. Coals roar, quench barrels hiss, and a horned smith scowls if you let cold air in.

rows.title: Shrine of the Dawnmother
rows.blurb: Cool stone, candles, coloured light through a small saint-glass window.

rows.title: Hayward's Stables
rows.blurb: Hay, warm horses, swallows in the rafters. Mud tracks the yard; tack hangs on pegs.

rows.title: Archery Range
rows.blurb: Straw butts, painted targets, a rope line. Wind off the meadow knocks arrows off course.

rows.title: Graveyard
rows.blurb: Mossy stones, yew trees, a crooked iron fence. A crow watches from the lychgate.

rows.title: Crypt
rows.blurb: Cold steps, bone niches, one great stone sarcophagus. Dead candles crumble underfoot.

rows.title: Mayor's House
rows.blurb: Ivy-clad stone, a clipped garden, polished oak inside. Portraits of fat ancestors line the hall.

rows.title: Town Jail
rows.blurb: Damp cells, mouldy straw, a dozing jailer and a bold rat.

rows.title: Woods Edge
rows.blurb: Three paths bite into the trees: cart ruts, damp gorge noise, and bone chimes on a deer trail.

rows.title: Wrecked Cart
rows.blurb: An overturned iron cart, a dead ox, and goblin prints in the mud.

rows.title: Pip's Hiding Tree
rows.blurb: A hollow oak; flour on the bark. Someone whimpers above.

rows.title: Goblin Lookout
rows.blurb: Rope ladder to a treetop platform. A bronze horn hangs on a peg.

rows.title: Goblin Cave Mouth
rows.blurb: A mossy bank cave. Bones on stakes grin at the path.

rows.title: Mushroom Glade
rows.blurb: Grey caps crowd a sunny hollow. The air smells of loam and rain.

rows.title: Troll Bridge
rows.blurb: A rope bridge sags over a black gorge. Something grunts underneath.

rows.title: Far Side
rows.blurb: The gorge ends on a high shelf of grey stone. Wind tears at your cloak; below, the river is a black thread.

rows.title: Mother Sedge's Hut
rows.blurb: A crooked hut on stilts. Herbs dry on the eaves; a pot bubbles.

rows.title: Witch's Cellar
rows.blurb: Damp steps, jars on shelves. One jar holds a toad with human eyes.

rows.title: Old Shrine
rows.blurb: A cracked sun disc leans in ivy. Warm light pulses once, then waits.

rows.title: Fairy Fountain
rows.blurb: A glowing spring in a mossy bowl. The water is warm and utterly still.

rows.title: Guard Tunnel
rows.blurb: Two goblins slump against the walls, jugs in their laps.

rows.title: Mushroom Farm
rows.blurb: Glowing caps in dung beds.

rows.title: Brewery
rows.blurb: Copper vats bubble. Fumes sting your eyes; goblins laugh at their work.

rows.title: Mess Hall
rows.blurb: Long tables, shouting goblins, barrels rolling underfoot.

rows.title: Cask Cellar
rows.blurb: Stacked casks breathe old wine. Cobwebs hang thick above.

rows.title: Brewmaster's Throne
rows.blurb: A throne of kegs. A bloated goblin chief drains a brass hose.

rows.title: Prisoner Pens
rows.blurb: Wooden cages. Two humans watch you through the slats.

rows.title: Loot Pile
rows.blurb: Stolen iron, town goods, and coin heaped behind the throne.

rows.title: Spore Pit
rows.blurb: Pale fungus breathes up from a pit. The air tastes like copper.

rows.title: Shaman's Den
rows.blurb: A wizened goblin in a mushroom hat mutters over a brazier.

rows.title: Underground River
rows.blurb: A black river slides through the stone. Barrels spin in the current.

rows.title: Northwood Trace
rows.blurb: An old ranger cut peters out in briars.
